# viettelcloud_db_backup (Data Source)

Find one manual or automatic backup of a Viettel Cloud DBaaS DB instance by ID or exact filters. name, db_instance_id, and backup_type together always select at most one backup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_db_backup" "example" {
  name           = "example-db-backup"
  db_instance_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  backup_type    = "manual"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_type` (String) Backup type: manual or automatic.
- `database_type` (String) Database type.
- `db_instance_id` (String) Source DB instance ID (UUID). Null after the instance is deleted with keep_backup = true.
- `id` (String) Backup ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Exact backup name.
- `region` (String) Exact region name.
- `status` (String) Exact backup status, such as COMPLETED.

### Read-Only

- `backup_info` (String) Backup details that the backend reports.
- `backup_plan_id` (String) Backup plan ID (UUID), if any.
- `backup_timestamp` (String) Time the backup completed (RFC3339).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `db_instance_name` (String) Source DB instance name.
- `db_version` (String) DB version of the source instance.
- `db_version_id` (String) DB version ID (UUID).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `end_restore_timestamp` (String) Latest restore time (RFC3339), if any.
- `error_message` (String) Last error that the backend reported.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `required_volume_size` (Number) Minimum volume size in GB to restore the backup.
- `size` (Number) Backup size in MB.
- `start_restore_timestamp` (String) Earliest restore time (RFC3339), if any.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID), if any.
